caption:
A Madhya Pradesh district just got its first railway line since Independence. Nearly 80 years without one.

On October 24, 2026, two new rail sections - Satna-Devendranagar and Rewa-Churhat, together 118 km - were inaugurated under the Lalitpur-Singrauli Railway Project. The Rs 1,070 crore Rewa-Churhat section finally gives Sidhi district rail connectivity it never had since Independence, with a new Devendranagar-Churhat passenger service flagged off the same day.

Independence came in 1947. A train finally came to Sidhi in 2026.

Sources: Swarajya Mag, News on Air (2026)
